verdict.rationale: Claude Code explicitly supports cross-device continuity: kick off tasks on web/mobile and pull them into terminal via `claude --teleport`, use Remote Control to keep working from phone/browser, run in-browser with no local setup, and manage all sessions in one 'Agent view'. missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of the teleport/remote-control handoff working reliably, and details on session state sync limitations.
